# Jeremiah 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Words-of Jeremiah son-of Hilkiah, from-the-priests who [were] in-Anathoth in-[the]-land-of Benjamin,

**2** To-whom came [the]-word-of YHWH in-[the]-days-of Josiah son-of Amon, king-of Judah, in-the-thirteenth year of-his-reign.

**3** And-it-came in-[the]-days-of Jehoiakim son-of Josiah, king-of Judah, until [the]-end-of [the]-eleventh year of-Zedekiah son-of Josiah, king-of Judah, until [the]-exile-of Jerusalem in-the-fifth month.

**4** And-came [the]-word-of YHWH to-me, saying:

**5** "Before I-formed-you in-the-womb I-knew-you, and-before you-came-forth from-[the]-womb I-consecrated-you; a-prophet to-the-nations I-appointed-you."

**6** And-I-said, "Ah, Lord YHWH! Behold, I-do-not-know [how]-to-speak, for a-youth I [am]."

**7** And-YHWH said to-me, "Do-not-say, 'A-youth I [am],' for upon everything which I-send-you, you-shall-go, and-everything which I-command-you, you-shall-speak.

**8** Do-not-be-afraid of-their-faces, for with-you I [am] to-deliver-you," declares YHWH.

**9** And-YHWH stretched-out His-hand and-touched my-mouth, and-YHWH said to-me, "Behold, I-have-put My-words in-your-mouth.

**10** See, I-have-appointed-you this-day over the-nations and-over the-kingdoms, to-uproot and-to-tear-down and-to-destroy and-to-overthrow, to-build and-to-plant."

**11** And-came [the]-word-of YHWH to-me, saying, "What [do]-you see, Jeremiah?" And-I-said, "A-branch-of an-almond-tree I see."

**12** And-YHWH said to-me, "You-have-done-well to-see, for watching I [am] over My-word to-perform-it."

**13** And-came [the]-word-of YHWH to-me a-second-time, saying, "What [do]-you see?" And-I-said, "A-pot boiling I see, and-its-face [is] from-[the]-face-of [the]-north."

**14** And-YHWH said to-me, "From-[the]-north the-evil will-be-opened upon all [the]-inhabitants-of the-land.

**15** For behold-Me calling to-all [the]-families-of [the]-kingdoms-of [the]-north," declares YHWH, "and-they-will-come and-set each his-throne at-[the]-entrance-of [the]-gates-of Jerusalem, and-against all her-walls around, and-against all [the]-cities-of Judah.

**16** And-I-will-speak My-judgments against-them concerning all their-evil, [in]-that they-forsook-Me and-burned-incense to-other gods, and-bowed-down to-[the]-works-of their-hands.

**17** And-you, gird your-loins, and-arise and-speak to-them everything which I command-you. Do-not-be-dismayed before-them, lest I-dismay-you before-them.

**18** And-I, behold, I-have-made-you this-day a-city fortified and-a-pillar-of iron and-walls-of bronze against all the-land — against [the]-kings-of Judah, against her-princes, against her-priests, and-against the-people-of the-land.

**19** And-they-will-fight against-you but-will-not-prevail against-you, for with-you I [am]," declares YHWH, "to-deliver-you."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **1:5**: Be-terem etzorkha — 'before I formed you.' YHWH's knowledge of Jeremiah precedes his physical existence. Predestination language in prophetic call.

- **1:11-12**: Shaqed/shoqed wordplay — 'almond' (shaqed) and 'watching' (shoqed). The almond tree blooms first in spring; YHWH is 'watchful' to fulfill His word.

- **1:10**: Six infinitives: four destructive (uproot, tear down, destroy, overthrow), two constructive (build, plant). Jeremiah's ministry is predominantly judgment, then restoration.

— EMET
